segments.he: רבינו ז"ל אמר ייני לייט וועלין זיך גפונין וויא קיין מענטשין גייאין ניט, אין וויא קיין היינער קרייאין מט. היינו שיהי' להם התבודדות והנעור בלילה.
segments.en: Concerning Reb Asher of Apeler, one of the elders of our fellowship, father-in-law of Reb Ayzik of Uman. A man came to him and challenged him with difficult philosophical questions. One of our fellowship answered him with a parable: A man once entered a house and stood upside down — head below and feet above — and cried out that the whole house and everything in it was upside down. A sensible man came and told him: "The house is not upside down — you are upside down. Right yourself and you will see that everything in the house is perfectly straight." And then he said to the questioner: "Dayn moykh iz iberkert — dukht zikh dir az alts iz iberkert. Zloakh dayn moykh — vet als zayn gleykh." [Your mind is overturned — that is why everything seems overturned to you. Straighten out your mind and everything will be straight.]
